name: airo-doffy-wrm-claude-select-c12-bs32
description: WRM_claude architecture-selection run: 100 train / 25 held-out episodes, batch size 32, cluster 12, 100k steps with milestones every 10k

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_wrm_claude_select_cluster12_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-wrm-claude-select-cluster12-bs32.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
